class.name: NNBTBlackboardCompare
class.brief_description: Compares a blackboard value against a configured value.
class.description: Reads [member key] from the effective [NNBlackboard] of the nearest [NNBTRoot] ancestor and compares the stored value with [member value] using [member operator]. Returns [code]SUCCESS[/code] when the comparison holds and [code]FAILURE[/code] otherwise. A missing key, a null-valued key, or an incompatible pair of types makes the comparison fail ([code]FAILURE[/code]) without an engine error and without crashing. An empty [member key] or a missing [NNBTRoot] ancestor with a blackboard is a configuration error that is reported once per node instance. This leaf is fully data-driven: it is configured entirely by its properties, does not call and is not affected by an [code]on_tick[/code] override in an attached script, and works on the effective [NNBlackboard] of the nearest [NNBTRoot] ancestor through the [NoodleNodes] blackboard helpers.

members.member: The blackboard key to read. Must be non-empty; an empty key reports an error once and returns [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE]. A missing or [code]null[/code] stored value also returns [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE].

The comparison to perform between the stored value and [member value] (left-hand side is the stored value). Values outside the [enum Operator] range are rejected with a single engine error that names [code]set_operator[/code], the received value and the valid range; the previous operator is kept.
The right-hand value to compare the stored blackboard value against using Godot's [Variant] comparison rules. Incompatible types return [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE].

constants.constant: The stored value does not equal [member value].
The stored value is greater than [member value].
The stored value is less than [member value].
The stored value is greater than or equal to [member value].
The stored value is less than or equal to [member value].
